settings.title: Judo Puzzle Mats
settings.text: The Judo Puzzle Mat is the ideal mat for Judo and grappling based arts. Each mat measures 40mm (+/- 2mm @ 21C/70F) thick, by 3’3” by 3’3” or 11 square feet. This mat is reversible so that you can create unique rings and training areas. We don’t recommend that you conduct stand up fighting (i.e. kicking) on these mats as they are softer.

settings.text: The interlocking Judo mats are easily installed. Simply piece together the mats in the configuration you want. Note that the arrow-head corner of each mat must be facing the same direction to interlock properly. These mats are fully reversible and have the edge borders included.
